source.schema: Ownerless spare-ammo actor cItemSetInfo: actor+0x1C36 BE u16 ID, +0x1C38 BE u32 count
source.mutation: One guarded six-byte source write to ID0x10F/count1. Carried inventory IDs, existing weapon pointers, ownership and models are never written.
source.guards: Exact build/native constructor signatures; actor class, handle, source class, collision-volume identity/enabled flag, ownership, stable bounded item list, current player, free grid slot, supported route, observed enemy/mine margins.
source.cancellation: Only an unchanged unconsumed source with matching actor identity is restored. Unknown or changing item lists retain the donor and report restoration_pending. Already-created native inventory is retained. A new player or round ends the request; bot shutdown schedules guarded cleanup.
source.scope: Adapter/process identity, PID, process generation, input-controller owner and current player fence the request. The resolved Linux guest PID/base or Windows base/process handle also must match, including a fresh guest-resolution check immediately before writes. Pending creation expires after 120 seconds. Old-process source writes are forbidden. Newer operator weapon choices supersede the request.

factory.shared_branch: Calls0x00151540(kind7,itemID,variant0); the factory resolves the class registration before creating its unit.
factory.completion: The native cItem must be active, ID0x10F, loaded and in hand; its real weapon pointer must have the bow vtable and owner+0x111C matching the current player. Re-read both owners and inventory before reporting equipped. This proves native class/owner, not rendered model residency.
factory.inventory_layout: The parser record starts four bytes before native cItem. Native cItem ID+4, count+8, active+0x29 and weapon+0x2C correspond to parser record+8, +0xC, +0x2D and +0x30; parser stride is 0x30.

runtime_contract.tool: re5_mods op=live_weapon weapon=15 on=true; on=false cancels
runtime_contract.completion: queued is never applied. inventory_present only confirms cItem; native_created requires the bow weapon class/owner. status.live_weapon.verified/completed are true only with current native equipped-bow evidence and a fresh active input controller.
runtime_contract.input_owner: Existing RE5 bot handles exact native pickup prompt, supported-floor navigation, quick-slot input or verified ordinary inventory-menu equip.
runtime_contract.other_weapons: Explicitly unsupported by this live supply operation; the separate next-round template control remains available.
runtime_contract.no_restart: The operation does not quit, restart, end the round, relaunch the emulator or write boot templates.

limits.donor: No spare ownerless ammo or no free inventory slot leaves the request pending; no native give-item mailbox exists in this RE5 implementation.
limits.live_acceptance: Static native factory path and live signatures investigated; successful active-round bow pickup/model/equip acceptance must be recorded separately. Unit tests do not establish that runtime outcome.
limits.speed: Existing fire-rate table/timer scaling is not measured bow shots per second. The native animation accelerator is verified for magnums, not the longbow.
limits.only_weapon: This operation equips a native bow and preserves other carried items. It does not delete other weapons.
